FN-YMBHYN2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 282
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Rhett Marques
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 282 as introduced would prohibit any state or local governmental entity from
contracting with media monitoring organizations or any marketing or advertising agency that
uses such an organization. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
